identity.name: Casio Classic A158
identity.one_liner: The 1987 A158 — the chrome-and-resin square watch that defined the affordable digital category. The F-91W's slightly fancier sibling.

narrative.story: The A158WA was introduced in 1987 as the chrome-and-resin variant of the F-91W. The chrome bezel and bracelet-style resin strap made the watch a slightly more dressed-up alternative to the all-resin F-91W. The 593 quartz module is the same as the F-91W, with the 7-year battery, daily alarm, hourly chime, stopwatch, and calendar. The A158 is the most-cited affordable "dress digital" watch and the watch a watch collector buys as their second watch for the office.
narrative.collector_notes: The A158WA and F-91W share the 593 module. The differences are the chrome bezel and the case dimensions (A158 is 36.8mm wide, F-91W is 33.2mm wide).
